assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The ICD-10 code I25.10 is assigned for atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The ICD-10 code I34.0 is assigned for nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
The payer states that this service requires pre-approval to ensure medical necessity and coverage eligibility
The required precertification was not obtained before services were rendered
The claim was denied under Reason Code CO-197
